text: I saw a therapist after the breakup, partly for the depression and partly to understand what had happened that night. She helped me see that the mushrooms had amplified real issues but also distorted them. I've started dating again, carefully. My ex and I had one conversation a year later, which was sad but healing.
Ich habe eine Verhaltenstherapie gemacht, die mir bei der Angst in Menschenmengen etwas geholfen hat. Ich übe noch, z.B. mit vollen Bahnen. Festivals sind für mich vorbei.

I went back into an eating disorder day programme for three months. My treatment team was supportive and didn't judge me for the mushrooms, which I was afraid of. I'm in outpatient therapy now and have been stable for a year. I've told everyone in my recovery group about this, so that nobody else gets the same idea from a friend.
Wir haben beide viel darüber geredet, auch mit seiner Familie. Ein paar Gespräche bei einer Trauerberatung haben mir geholfen, das Erlebte einzuordnen.
Reading Buddhist texts on suffering, meditation, and volunteering at the hospice. Talking to the hospice chaplain. These help, but the dread hasn't fully gone.

Years later, in my twenties, I started therapy and finally talked about that day. My therapist helped me understand that my brother was also a teenager carrying too much. Eventually I talked to my mother about what had happened when I was a baby. She was relieved, in a way, and we became closer. My brother and I have talked too. It took a long time.

Ich habe mit einer Psychologin gesprochen, die auch mit Pflegekräften arbeitet. Sie hat mir geholfen zu verstehen, dass Schuldgefühle in meinem Beruf häufig sind und dass ich nicht für jeden Tod verantwortlich bin. Ich gehe regelmäßig zur Supervision in meinem Team. Inzwischen kann ich wieder gut arbeiten.

I saw my regular psychiatrist, who adjusted my antidepressant. I told her about the corridors and she said dissociative experiences on ketamine aren't rare. A few months of therapy helped with the fear of sedation. I had a minor operation last year and managed it with a lot of preparation.

I've tried therapy, which was helpful for the depression and the sense of being judged. I've also been reading about religious experiences, philosophy of mind and mysticism, trying to find a framework that makes sense. I joined a discussion group of people who've had similar experiences, which helps me feel less crazy. I'm still searching. I don't think there's a simple 'treatment' for having your worldview shattered.
CBT with exposure and response prevention. It helps a lot but I still check more than I'd like.

Ich musste damals zu einer Drogenberatung, was ich als Strafe empfunden habe, aber die Beraterin war eigentlich sehr nett. Später habe ich eine Psychotherapie gemacht, wegen der Depression. Das hat geholfen. Heute verstehe ich mich wieder gut mit meinen Eltern.
